Neither record carries any context flag (`is_test`, `is_codegen`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`) that would mark the duplication as intentional. Having two names for the same structural type in the same package creates confusion about which name is authoritative and forces readers to mentally track the equivalence.

specifics.why_no_category_fits: Both records are `type-alias-union` kinds, not concrete types, protocols, or functions. The standard refactor categories (extract-to-common, protocol-inheritance, generic-parameterization, etc.) all assume concrete or protocol types. 'extract-to-common' is the closest fit but is misleading because both aliases already live in the same package (`Metadata`) — there is nothing to move across a package boundary.
